purpose: Optional helper scripts the scan agent may use through Bash when they fit the current target behavior.
rules: Scripts are optional helpers, not mandatory checks.
Use them only when they match the current endpoint or traffic.
Verify useful output with dast_tool.py or curl before report_finding.

tools.name: tool_router
tools.description: Generic endpoint fingerprint router. Classifies any supplied request/response into relevant test modules: JWT, input injection, API auth logic, IDOR/BOLA, SSRF/open redirect, XXE, file upload, LFI/path traversal, clickjacking/headers, and baseline cookie/header checks.
when_to_use: When a Proxy/Burp request context includes headers or body
Before choosing specialized tools or payload families
report_only_if: The selected module evidence_required items are satisfied
There is a baseline vs attack response difference or a clear passive configuration issue
A copy-paste curl or dast_tool command can reproduce the proof

tools.name: jwt_tool
tools.description: Decode JWTs, generate safe negative test variants, and replay the same HTTP request with valid/tampered tokens to compare status and response body.
when_to_use: Cookie value looks like a JWT
Response, local storage, or JavaScript exposes a JWT
report_only_if: A tampered, unsigned, expired, or bad-signature token is accepted with HTTP 200 or privileged data
A normal unprivileged user can change JWT claims and gain access
The result is confirmed by replaying the affected request

tools.name: clickjacking_tool
tools.description: Check whether a page has frame protections and optionally create a simple iframe PoC page for OWASP WSTG clickjacking testing.
when_to_use: HTML page contains authenticated or sensitive actions
Testing UI redress or clickjacking exposure
Need to verify X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors behavior
report_only_if: The page is frameable because both X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors are missing or weak
The frameable page contains sensitive authenticated data or user actions
The result is verified with the generated iframe PoC or equivalent browser test
